summary: Batches 1 + 2 (Inventory Control Tower + Partner Receiving/Put-away + Stock Counts) fully validated. Backend: 24/24 pytest cases passed covering Super Admin CT endpoints (KPIs, overview, SKU drilldown, stores, low/OOS, movements), Receiving flow (draft→verify→put-away→completed) with all 409 guardrails, and Stock Counts flow (create→record→apply) including never-negative & movement-in-ledger checks. Frontend: Super Admin /admin/inventory renders live KPIs (Total SKUs=4, Available=232, Reserved=0, Low=0, OOS=1, Inventory value=162,750 CFA, 2 stores), tabs & drilldown dialogs work, movements ledger shows real ledger entries (put_away, stock_count). Partner portal Receiving flow (RCPT-000004 draft→completed with 5 units) works end-to-end; Stock counts flow (CNT-000003 counted→reconciling→completed with -1 variance) works and produces a stock_count movement in the network ledger. Dashboard 'Warehouse operations' KPI row visible (Pending receiving/put-away/counts). No multi-store switcher present in partner portal navigation.

minor.issue: product_name is null in the ledger for partner products sourced from master (source=master). The route joins PartnerProduct only; should COALESCE PartnerProduct.name with MartProduct.name (via master_product_id) so the Movements table shows a name for every row.

ui_bugs.issue: Dialogs don't close on ESC key or backdrop click; only the ✕ button closes them.
PRODUCT column is blank for stock_count / put_away rows whose partner_product is source=master (backend product_name null). Cosmetic knock-on of the backend issue above.

There is no input for expected_qty; the modal only exposes received_qty (so the requested expected=50/received=48 pattern cannot be entered from the UI — both default to 0/typed value). Backend supports expected_qty via API.
Uses native window.confirm() instead of a themed shadcn Dialog. Works but feels off-brand and breaks e2e scripts that don't auto-accept dialogs.

action_items: Backend: In /admin/inventory/movements, coalesce product_name with MartProduct.name via LEFT JOIN on PartnerProduct.master_product_id so master-sourced SKUs show a name in the Movements ledger.
Frontend: Close SKU/Store detail dialogs on ESC key press and backdrop click (add onKeyDown + backdrop onClick handlers).
Frontend (optional): Add an 'Expected qty' input to the New Receipt line-item form so partners can log variance vs. supplier expectation.
Frontend (optional): Replace window.confirm() in StockCountsPage.createFull with a themed confirmation dialog.
critical_code_review_comments: inventory_control_tower.py /overview: uses func.string_agg(PartnerProduct.id, ',') — Postgres-specific, fine here since project runs on PG. Just note it will break on SQLite tests if any suite ever swaps engines.

inventory_ops_routes.py apply_count: correctly clamps available_qty to max(0, counted_qty); movement.delta_qty is (new - old) which can be negative or zero — verified in test_never_negative (counted=0, previous=49 → delta=-49, balance=0).
Receipt cancel guard properly refuses when any item.put_away_qty > 0 (verified). Verify guard rejects verified/completed/put_away/cancelled (verified via 409 test).
